anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive Dusk Wholesale Fish-Market Wharf, Kaleidoscopic Bereavement Threshold & Reciprocal Staring-Gaze Mirror with Procedural Harbor Bell/Wave/Sigh WebAudio

stones.living_wharf_form: Sailor catching the wet mooring hawser among dock porters at dusk landing
stones.traveler_memory: A soldier resembling my father the day before he died, leaving for war in a dark tunic
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Lost youngest son swept overboard in the winter gale off Negroponte

stones.living_wharf_form: Bearded old fisherman with crusty, warty hands beside wicker baskets of purple sea urchins
stones.traveler_memory: A comrade who sailed with me long ago and succumbed to sea-fever
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Twin brother dragged beneath the tide with a weighted urchin-dredge thirty autumns past

stones.living_wharf_form: Fever victim huddled shivering on a damp straw mat beneath the limestone arch
stones.traveler_memory: A man with yellow eyes whom I visited in his delirium an hour before his last breath
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Cousin from the salt-marshes who perished of the same yellow ague beside this pillar

stones.living_wharf_form: Stevedores climbing the gangplank and steep stairs with coarse sacks folded over their heads as hoods
stones.traveler_memory: Friends dead long ago, bent beneath sackcloth hoods as though climbing out of memory
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Quarry companion crushed under fallen limestone on the upper necropolis stair

stones.living_wharf_form: Pale veiled girl leaning motionless from a wrought-iron balcony above the dusk thoroughfare
stones.traveler_memory: The girl who killed herself for an unrequited love, still leaning into the twilight
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Betrothed mariner who sailed out at equinox and drowned before returning to her casement

stones.living_wharf_form: Stooped old vegetable vendor weighing dark greens on a hanging brass pan-scale
stones.traveler_memory: My grandmother's stooped shoulders and veined fingers steadying the brass balance
stones.citizen_reciprocal_dead: Firstborn daughter lost in childbirth, wearing your exact brow and startled gaze

inner_arch.forehead_doubt: Touching his forehead at dusk, the traveler first wonders whether Adelma is the land where one arrives upon dying.
inner_arch.kaleidoscopic_threshold: At a certain point in life, when the dead you have known outnumber the living, the mind refuses to accept more faces and covers every new stranger with old faces like kaleidoscopic masks.
inner_arch.reciprocal_gaze_terror: Every inhabitant stares back with fixed eyes: you dare neither hold their gaze nor look away, because each citizen recognizes in YOUR face the likeness of someone who died for THEM.

adelma-critic.role: Blindfolded read-only verifier for HG-1..HG-4 and Royal Plates (map.png, map.svg, image.png)

hard_gates.HG-1: 100% standalone index.html & layers/*.js: zero http://, https://, ../, fetch(, or external links; node --check clean; zero runtime/console errors.
hard_gates.HG-2: Anti-Trude bespoke DOM morphology: all 5 chartered custom tags (<adelma-dusk-landing>, <wharf-encounter-stage>, <bereavement-kaleidoscope>, <reciprocal-gaze-mirror>, <adelma-plate-drawer>), zero generic layout tags, 100% .adl-* CSS classes, J_dom < 0.35.
hard_gates.HG-3: Calvino causal fidelity: all 6 canonical wharf stones interactive with procedural harbor/bell/sigh WebAudio; life-loss slider crossing dead > living saturates all 12 wharf faces into departed masks; meeting any citizen's eyes flips the reciprocal mirror to reveal whose dead face YOU wear for them and raises gazeParalysis.
hard_gates.HG-4: Responsive 1280x800 & 390x844 with zero viewport overflow, prefers-reduced-motion support, full keyboard shortcuts, and inspectable [P] <adelma-plate-drawer> verifying pre-existing map.png (1600x1200), map.svg, and image.png (1600x1000).
